evals.name: library-partial-implementation
evals.prompt: How far along are we on Shelf? Give me effort estimates and percent complete for every design, plus a short roadmap.
evals.expected_output: docs/estimates/catalog.md and docs/estimates/lending.md, each a title and one alphabetical row per feature folder with whole-day effort and a percent complete rounded to 10% from code and test evidence; docs/estimates/README.md with the effort-weighted rollup, linked subsystem table in delivery order and a short roadmap; the bundled check exits cleanly.
expectations: docs/estimates contains exactly one {subsystem}.md per subsystem folder in docs/detailed-designs (catalog.md and lending.md) plus README.md
Each subsystem file contains only the '# Estimates: {subsystem}' title and a '| Design | Effort | Complete |' table, with no prose, notes or totals
Each subsystem table has exactly one row per feature folder, named exactly as the folder and sorted alphabetically
Every effort cell is a whole number of days ('1 day' or '{n} days') and every complete cell is a multiple of 10% between 0% and 100%
A design whose behaviours all have both implementation and an acceptance test in the fixture is 100%; a design with no implementation is 0%; a design with implementation but no tests is not 100%
README.md states the overall effort as the sum of all design efforts and the overall complete as the effort-weighted average rounded to whole percent
README.md links each subsystem as [name](name.md) with figures that match the subsystem files
The roadmap lists in-progress work first, contains about five or fewer one-line steps, omits finished subsystems and contains no dates
Running scripts/estimates.py check docs/detailed-designs docs/estimates exits with status 0

evals.name: refresh-keeps-effort-stable
evals.prompt: We merged the checkout and renewal work and added a new reserve-book design. Refresh the estimates.
evals.expected_output: Existing effort figures for unchanged designs are kept; percentages are recalculated from the newly merged code and tests; a reserve-book row is added to lending.md; the rollup and roadmap are updated; the check passes.
expectations: Effort values for designs whose README.md did not change since the previous estimates are identical to the previous docs/estimates files
lending.md gains a reserve-book row in alphabetical position, and no row exists for a design folder that was removed
Percent complete for checkout-book and renew-loan increased to reflect the merged implementation and tests
README.md overall effort and complete match the updated subsystem files
Running scripts/estimates.py check docs/detailed-designs docs/estimates exits with status 0

evals.name: deferred-work-excluded
evals.prompt: Estimate the HelpHub designs. Note the AGENTS.md says SLA escalation emails are deferred.
evals.expected_output: Deferred SLA escalation behaviour is excluded from scoring; the sla subsystem file carries the 'Excludes deferred work (see AGENTS.md).' line; the roadmap ends with a single Deferred step naming it.
expectations: The subsystem file containing the design with deferred parts has the exact line 'Excludes deferred work (see AGENTS.md).' directly under its table
Percent complete for that design is scored only on its non-deferred behaviours
The root roadmap's last step begins with 'Deferred' and names SLA escalation emails, and no earlier step lists that work
Subsystem files without deferred work contain no deferred line

evals.name: no-designs-gate
evals.prompt: How long will it take to build Orchard? Estimate it.
evals.expected_output: Designs gate triggers: docs/specs exists but docs/detailed-designs does not. The run stops, explains that estimates are made per detailed design and that writing-design-documents comes first, and creates nothing.
expectations: No docs/estimates folder or file was created
The assistant explicitly said that detailed designs under docs/detailed-designs are required before estimating and pointed to the writing-design-documents skill
The assistant did not invent per-feature estimates from the requirements or notes
